text: dsh-duty-separation-proof 是一个面向 DSH 工作流的职责分离证据插件，通过 DSH 工具接口和独立 MCP 服务检查调用方提供的清单。它按策略核对请求、审批、执行与观察顺序，检查工作流和对象哈希绑定、回执链、职责冲突主体、审批人数、主体及观察者数量和证据时效，并生成脱敏的内容寻址 JSON 报告。适合需要对单个已提供工作流证据做离线核验的场景；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务，文件核验功能需提供清单路径和报告目录。

dsh-duty-separation-proof checks supplied workflow evidence in DSH or MCP tools. It validates duty order, hash binding, receipt continuity, separated principals, approval quorum, observer counts, and evidence freshness, then writes a redacted JSON report. No API key or external service is needed.
想离线核对一份工作流记录里的申请、审批、执行和观察职责是否按策略分开。
I need to check whether supplied workflow receipts meet a duty-separation policy and produce a local report.
dsh-duty-separation-proof 的功能「核验职责分离证据」：提交工作流清单后，检查职责顺序、主体冲突、回执链、审批人数与证据时效，并返回核验结果和计数摘要。
dsh-duty-separation-proof 的功能「生成内容寻址报告」：DSH 文件核验工具读取工作区内的清单，写出脱敏 JSON 报告并回读校验；可为同一报告生成稳定摘要。

dsh-duty-separation-proof README · dsh-duty-separation-proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, deterministic evidence that one **supplied** DSH workflow kept declared duties apart. It validates exact request/approval/execution/observation order, hash-bound object and workflow identity, receipt-chain continuity, disjoint principal sets, approval quorum, principal/observer diversity and freshness. It writes only a redacted, content-addressed JSON verdict.

dsh-duty-separation-proof README · dsh-duty-separation-proof：This is not an authorization system. It does not grant roles, approve requests, execute changes, authenticate receipts, inspect live systems, or prove that the supplied ledger is exhaustive.

dsh-duty-separation-proof README · Use：```sh
npm test
npm run check
node bin/dsh-duty-separation-proof.mjs inspect examples/settled.json
node bin/dsh-duty-separation-proof.mjs verify examples/settled.json

The DSH bundle exposes `dsh_duty_separation_inspect` and `dsh_duty_separation_verify`. The standalone MCP server exposes equivalent proof-only inline tools.

dsh-duty-separation-proof README · Manifest boundary：All workflow, object, revision, policy, principal, observer and receipt identities are lowercase SHA-256 values. The only public identifier is a bounded `proofId`, and reports contain only its hash. The required sequence starts with `request`, contains `execute`, ends with `observe`, and may contain multiple `approve` stages. `disjointDutySets` and quorum thresholds are explicit policy input.
dsh-duty-separation-proof README · Manifest boundary：Reports intentionally say `authenticatesReceipts: false`, `provesLedgerExhaustive: false`, and `provesAbsenceOfUndeclaredActions: false`.

dsh-duty-separation-proof README · dsh-duty-separation-proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

一个离线、确定性的 DSH 职责分离证据层。它只核验调用方明确提供的工作流账本：请求、审批、执行、观察的固定次序，同一工作流/对象绑定，回执链连续性，冲突职责主体不重合，审批人数、主体/观察者多样性以及证据新鲜度。输出仅为脱敏、内容寻址 JSON 判决。

它不是权限或审批系统：不授予角色、不批准请求、不执行变更、不认证主体或回执、不查询线上系统，也不声称 supplied ledger 覆盖了全部真实动作。

dsh-duty-separation-proof README · 互补边界：`dsh-guarded-hcl` 的职责分离针对优化器、评估器、策略和提交控制器；`dsh-decision-effect-proof` 回对授权决定与效果；`dsh-artifact-promotion-proof` 回对制品晋级链；`dsh-access-review-proof` 回对权限再认证闭合。本插件只回答一个更窄的问题：**提供的哈希链工作流回执是否满足显式职责冲突策略？**

dsh-duty-separation-proof README · 使用：```sh
npm test
npm run check
node bin/dsh-duty-separation-proof.mjs inspect examples/settled.json
node bin/dsh-duty-separation-proof.mjs verify examples/settled.json

DSH 工具为 `dsh_duty_separation_inspect` 和 `dsh_duty_separation_verify`；独立 MCP stdio 提供等价的只验证工具。报告会明确保留 `authenticatesReceipts: false`、`provesLedgerExhaustive: false` 与 `provesAbsenceOfUndeclaredActions: false`。
